items.source: As a general rule for runtime-retained application annotations (for example, for transaction control, authorization, or service exposure), always use the lookup methods on this class (for example, findAnnotation(Method, Class) or getAnnotation(Method, Class)) instead of the plain annotation lookup methods in the JDK. You can still explicitly choose between a get lookup on the given class level only (getAnnotation(Method, Class)) and a find lookup in the entire inheritance hierarchy of the given method (findAnnotation(Method, Class)).
items.translation: 作为运行时保留的应用程序注解（例如用于事务控制、授权或服务暴露）的一般规则，始终使用此类的查找方法（例如 findAnnotation(Method, Class) 或 getAnnotation(Method, Class)），而不是 JDK 中的普通注解查找方法。您仍然可以明确选择仅在给定类级别上进行 get 查找（getAnnotation(Method, Class)）或在给定方法的整个继承层次结构中进行 find 查找（findAnnotation(Method, Class)）。

items.source: Most find*() methods and some get*() methods in this class provide support for finding annotations used as meta-annotations. Consult the javadoc for each method in this class for details. For fine-grained support for meta-annotations with attribute overrides in composed annotations, consider using the MergedAnnotations API directly or the more specific methods in AnnotatedElementUtils instead.
items.translation: 此类的多数 `find*()` 方法和部分 `get*()` 方法支持查找用作元注解的注解。有关详细信息，请查阅此类中每个方法的 javadoc。如需对带有 属性覆盖 的 组合注解 中的元注解提供细粒度支持，请直接使用 MergedAnnotations API，或使用 AnnotatedElementUtils 中更具体的方法。

items.source: An annotation is meta-present on an element if the annotation is declared as a meta-annotation on some other annotation which is present on the element. Annotation A is meta-present on another annotation if A is either directly present or meta-present on the other annotation.
items.translation: 如果某个注解在另一个存在于元素上的注解上被声明为元注解，则该注解在该元素上是元存在的。如果注解A直接存在或元存在于另一个注解上，则注解A在该另一个注解上是元存在的。

items.source: All public methods in this class that return annotations, arrays of annotations, or AnnotationAttributes transparently support attribute aliases configured via @AliasFor. Consult the various synthesizeAnnotation*(..) methods for details.
items.translation: 此类中所有返回注解、注解数组或 `AnnotationAttributes` 的公共方法均透明支持通过 `@AliasFor` 配置的属性别名。有关详细信息，请查阅各种 `synthesizeAnnotation*(..)` 方法。

items.source: This method mimics the functionality of AnnotatedElement.getAnnotationsByType(Class) with support for automatic detection of a container annotation declared via @Repeatable and with additional support for meta-annotations.
items.translation: 此方法模仿了 AnnotatedElement.getAnnotationsByType(Class) 的功能，并支持自动检测通过 @Repeatable 声明的 容器注解，同时提供对元注解的额外支持。

items.source: This method mimics the functionality of AnnotatedElement.getDeclaredAnnotationsByType(Class) with support for automatic detection of a container annotation declared via @Repeatable and with additional support for meta-annotations.
items.translation: 此方法模拟了 AnnotatedElement.getDeclaredAnnotationsByType(Class) 的功能，并支持自动检测通过 @Repeatable 声明的 容器注解，同时提供对元注解的额外支持。

items.source: Warning: this method operates generically on annotated elements. In other words, this method does not execute specialized search algorithms for classes or methods. If you require the more specific semantics of findAnnotation(Class, Class) or findAnnotation(Method, Class), invoke one of those methods instead.
items.translation: 警告：此方法在带注解的元素上以通用方式运行。换句话说，此方法不会为类或方法执行专门的搜索算法。如果您需要 findAnnotation(Class, Class) 或 findAnnotation(Method, Class) 的更具体语义，请调用这些方法之一。

items.source: Equivalent to calling getAnnotationAttributes(Annotation, boolean, boolean) with the classValuesAsString and nestedAnnotationsAsMap parameters set to false.
items.translation: 等同于调用getAnnotationAttributes(Annotation, boolean, boolean)，并将classValuesAsString和nestedAnnotationsAsMap参数设置为false。

items.source: Equivalent to calling getAnnotationAttributes(AnnotatedElement, Annotation, boolean, boolean) with the classValuesAsString and nestedAnnotationsAsMap parameters set to false.
items.translation: 等同于调用getAnnotationAttributes(AnnotatedElement, Annotation, boolean, boolean)，并将classValuesAsString和nestedAnnotationsAsMap参数设置为false。

items.source: This method simply delegates to synthesizeAnnotation(Map, Class, AnnotatedElement), supplying an empty map for the source attribute values and null for the AnnotatedElement.
items.translation: 此方法简单地委托给synthesizeAnnotation(Map, Class, AnnotatedElement)，为源属性值提供一个空映射，并为AnnotatedElement提供null。

items.source: Note that AnnotationAttributes is a specialized type of Map that is an ideal candidate for this method's attributes argument.
items.translation: 注意，`AnnotationAttributes` 是 `org.springframework.core.annotation` 包中的一个类，它是 `AnnotationAttributes` 一种专门化的 `Map`，是该方法`attributes`参数的理想候选者。

items.source: The standard Class API does not provide a mechanism for determining which class in an inheritance hierarchy actually declares an Annotation, so we need to handle this explicitly.
items.translation: 标准 `Class` API 未提供确定继承层次结构中实际声明了哪个 `Annotation` 的类的方法，因此我们需要显式处理此问题。

items.source: Equivalent to calling getAnnotationAttributes(Annotation, boolean, boolean) with the nestedAnnotationsAsMap parameter set to false.
items.translation: 等同于调用getAnnotationAttributes(Annotation, boolean, boolean)，并将参数设置为false。

items.source: This method explicitly handles class-level annotations which are not declared as inherited as well as meta-annotations and annotations on interfaces.
items.translation: 此方法显式处理类级别的注解，这些注解未声明为inherited 以及元注解和接口上的注解。

items.source: The standard Class API does not provide a mechanism for determining which class in an inheritance hierarchy actually declares one of several candidate annotations, so we need to handle this explicitly.
items.translation: 标准 `Class` API 不提供一种机制来确定继承层次结构中的哪个类实际声明了多个候选 `annotations 中的一个，因此我们需要显式处理此问题。

items.source: If the supplied clazz is an interface, only the interface itself will be checked. In accordance with standard meta-annotation semantics in Java, the inheritance hierarchy for interfaces will not be traversed. See the javadoc for the @Inherited meta-annotation for further details regarding annotation inheritance.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `clazz` 是一个接口，则仅检查该接口本身。根据 Java 中标准元注解语义，不会遍历接口的继承层次结构。有关注解继承的更多详细信息，请参阅 javadoc 中关于 `@Inherited` 元注解的内容。

items.source: Specifically, this method enforces attribute alias semantics for annotation attributes that are annotated with @AliasFor and replaces default value placeholders with their original default values.
items.translation: 具体来说，此方法对带有@AliasFor的注解属性强制执行属性别名语义，并将默认值占位符替换为其原始默认值。

items.source: Note that this method supports only a single level of meta-annotations. For support for arbitrary levels of meta-annotations, use findAnnotation(AnnotatedElement, Class) instead.
items.translation: 注意，此方法仅支持单级元注解。若要支持任意级别的元注解，请使用 findAnnotation(AnnotatedElement, Class) 代替。

items.source: Note that this method supports only a single level of meta-annotations. For support for arbitrary levels of meta-annotations, use findAnnotation(Method, Class) instead.
items.translation: 注意，此方法仅支持单级元注解。若要支持任意级别的元注解，请使用 findAnnotation(Method, Class) 代替。

items.source: This method mimics the functionality AnnotatedElement.getAnnotationsByType(Class) with additional support for meta-annotations.
items.translation: 此方法模仿了 AnnotatedElement.getAnnotationsByType(Class) 的功能，并额外支持元注解。

items.source: This method mimics the functionality of AnnotatedElement.getDeclaredAnnotationsByType(Class) with additional support for meta-annotations.
items.translation: 此方法模仿了 AnnotatedElement.getDeclaredAnnotationsByType(Class) 的功能，并额外支持元注解。

items.source: The supplied Class may represent any type.
items.translation: 提供的 `Class` 可能代表任何类型。

items.source: Note: This method does not determine if the annotation is inherited.
items.translation: 注意：此方法不会确定该注解是否继承。

items.translation: 此方法未失败表明，稍后尝试调用时，getAnnotationAttributes(Annotation) 也不会失败。

items.source: Note that this method supports only a single level of meta-annotations. For support for arbitrary levels of meta-annotations, use one of the find*() methods instead.
items.translation: 注意，此方法仅支持单级元注解。若要支持任意级别的元注解，请使用 find*() 方法之一。

items.source: Meta-annotations will be searched if the annotation is not directly present on the supplied element.
items.translation: 如果注解未直接存在于提供的元素上，将搜索元注解。

items.source: Meta-annotations will be searched if the annotation is not directly present on the method.
items.translation: 如果注解未直接存在于方法上，将搜索元注解。

items.source: Note: in this context, the term recursively means that the search process continues by returning to step #1 with the current interface, annotation, or superclass as the class to look for annotations on.
items.translation: 注意：在此上下文中，术语递归地意味着搜索过程通过返回到步骤#1并继续在当前接口、注解或父类上查找注解来执行。

items.source: The supplied map must contain a key-value pair for every attribute defined in the supplied annotationType that is not aliased or does not have a default value. Nested maps and nested arrays of maps will be recursively synthesized into nested annotations or nested arrays of annotations, respectively.
items.translation: 提供的映射必须包含为在提供的 `<code>annotationType` 中定义的每个属性（该属性未设置别名或没有默认值）提供的一个键值对。嵌套的映射和嵌套的映射数组将分别被递归地合成为嵌套的注解或嵌套的注解数组。

items.source:
Note that most of the features of this class are not provided by the
JDK's introspection facilities themselves.
items.translation: 注意，本类的许多功能并非由 JDK 的自省设施本身提供。

items.source:
The search algorithms used by methods in this class stop searching for
an annotation once the first annotation of the specified type has been
found. As a consequence, additional annotations of the specified type will
be silently ignored.
items.translation: 该类中方法所使用的搜索算法在找到第一个指定类型的注解后便会停止搜索。因此，额外的指定类型注解将被静默忽略。

items.source:
Annotations on methods are not inherited by default, so we need to handle
this explicitly.
items.translation: 方法上的注解默认不会被继承，因此我们需要显式地处理这种情况。

items.source: The algorithm operates as follows:
items.translation: 该算法按如下方式运行：

items.source: Synthesize an annotation from the supplied map of annotation attributes by wrapping the map in a dynamic proxy that implements an annotation of the specified annotationType and transparently enforces attribute alias semantics for annotation attributes that are annotated with @AliasFor.
items.translation: Synthesize 一个注解，通过用实现指定 annotationType 的注解的动态代理包装提供的注解属性映射，并透明地强制对带有 @AliasFor 注解的注解属性执行属性别名语义。

items.source: Retrieve the default value of the value attribute of a single-element Annotation, given the annotation type.
items.translation: 获取单个元素注解的 `value` 属性的 默认值，给定一个 annotation type。

items.source: Retrieve the default value of a named attribute, given the annotation type.
items.translation: 获取给定 注解类型 的命名属性的 默认值。

items.source: Determine if the Annotation with the supplied name is defined in the core JDK java.lang.annotation package.
items.translation: 确定在核心 JDK `java.lang.annotation` 包中是否定义了具有所提供名称的 `Annotation`。

items.source: Determine if the supplied Annotation is defined in the core JDK java.lang.annotation package.
items.translation: 确定提供的 Annotation 是否定义在核心 JDK 的 java.lang.annotation 包中。

items.source: Post-process the supplied AnnotationAttributes, preserving nested annotations as Annotation instances.
items.translation: 后处理提供的AnnotationAttributes，将嵌套的注解保留为Annotation实例。

items.source: Determine if an annotation of type metaAnnotationType is meta-present on the supplied annotationType.
items.translation: 确定类型 `metaAnnotationType` 的注解是否在提供的 `annotationType` 上以“元存在”（meta-present）形式存在。

items.source: Determine if the supplied Annotation has been synthesized by Spring (i.e. wrapped in a dynamic proxy) with additional functionality such as attribute alias handling.
items.translation: 确定提供的Annotation是否由 Spring 合成（即用动态代理包装）并添加了额外功能，例如属性别名处理。

items.source: Retrieve the default value of the value attribute of a single-element Annotation, given an annotation instance.
items.translation: 获取单个元素注解的 `value` 属性的默认值，给定一个注解实例。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the value attribute of a single-element Annotation, given an annotation instance.
items.translation: 获取单个元素注解的value属性的value，给定一个注解实例。

items.source: Retrieve the default value of a named attribute, given an annotation instance.
items.translation: 给定一个注解实例，检索命名属性的默认值。

items.source: Retrieve the value of a named attribute, given an annotation instance.
items.translation: 给定一个注解实例，检索其命名属性的value。

items.source: The attribute name for annotations with a single element.
items.translation: 单元素注解的属性名称。

items.source: Clear the internal annotation metadata cache.
items.translation: 清除内部注解元数据缓存。

items.source:
Determine whether the given class is a candidate for carrying one of the specified
annotations (at type, method or field level).
items.translation: 确定给定类是否为携带指定注解（在类型、方法或字段级别）的候选者。

items.source:
Register the annotation-declared default values for the given attributes,
if available.
items.translation: 注册给定属性的注解声明的默认值（如果可用）。

items.source: the first Class in the inheritance hierarchy that declares an annotation of the specified annotationType, or null if not found
items.translation: 继承层次结构中的第一个声明了指定 `annotationType` 注解的 `Class`，如果未找到则返回 `null`。

items.source: the first Class in the inheritance hierarchy that declares an annotation of at least one of the specified annotationTypes, or null if not found
items.translation: 继承层次结构中的第一个声明了至少一个指定 `annotationTypes` 的注解（或为 `Class`）的 `Class`，如果未找到则返回 `null`。

items.source: true if an annotation of the specified annotationType is present and inherited
items.translation: true 如果指定 annotationType 的注解存在且可继承

items.source: true if an annotation of the specified annotationType is directly present
items.translation: true 如果指定 annotationType 的注解是 直接存在

items.source: IllegalStateException - if a declared Class attribute could not be read
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法读取声明的 Class 属性

items.source: the synthesized annotation if the supplied annotation is synthesizable; null if the supplied annotation is null; otherwise the supplied annotation unmodified
items.translation: 如果提供的注解是可合成的，则返回合成的注解；如果提供的注解为`null`，则返回`null`；否则返回未修改的提供的注解。

items.translation: annotatedElement - 用于获取注解的 AnnotatedElement

items.translation: annotatedElement - 用于查找注解的 AnnotatedElement

items.translation: annotationTypes - 可搜索的注解类型

items.translation: annotation - 要检查的注解

items.translation: annotatedElement - 要从中检索注解的 Method、Constructor 或 Field
